units: <cite ref="Nedarim 66b:6">Ned. 66ᵇ</cite> <he>אמרו לו ס׳</he> they said to him, (her head is) round.—Pl. <he>סְגַלְגּלִּים</he>, <he>סְגַלְגַלִּין</he>; <he>סְגַלְגַּלּוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 31a:1">Sabb. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>מפני מה ראשיהן … ס׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>ראשם … סגלגל</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) why are the heads of the Babylonians round?
